root.label: std::format and print
root.note: A checked format string whose fields are handled by formatter<T>::parse and ::format.

children.label: Format string grammar
children.note: Literal text plus replacement fields with an optional index and spec.

children.label: Standard spec order
children.note: Fill and align, sign, #, 0, width, precision, L, then type.

children.label: Argument indexing
children.note: Use all automatic or all manual indices; mixing them is an error.

children.label: Nested width and precision
children.note: A nested {} takes width or precision from a non-negative standard integer argument.

children.label: Type-dependent defaults
children.note: Numbers align right, strings left; bool prints as text and char as a character.

children.label: Checking and errors
children.note: Errors surface at compile time when possible and as format_error otherwise.

children.label: format_string is consteval
children.note: A literal is parsed against the argument types at compile time.

children.label: vformat
children.note: Takes a runtime string and make_format_args of lvalues; throws format_error.

children.label: runtime_format (C++26)
children.note: Wraps a runtime string so std::format accepts it unchecked.

children.label: format_error
children.note: Thrown by vformat, bad dynamic widths, and formatters that reject a spec.

children.label: Custom formatters
children.note: Specialize std::formatter for your own type.

children.label: parse
children.note: Consumes the spec text and returns an iterator to the closing brace.

children.label: format const
children.note: Writes to ctx.out() and must be a const member function.

children.label: Reuse via delegation
children.note: Format into a string and pad with a standard formatter to get width support.

children.label: Ranges and tuples (C++23)
children.note: Containers, pairs and tuples are formattable when their elements are.

children.label: Default shapes
children.note: Sequences use brackets, sets and maps braces, tuples parentheses.

children.label: Element specs
children.note: In {::#x}, the second colon starts the spec applied to each element.

children.label: n option
children.note: {:n} removes the surrounding brackets or braces.

children.label: Output functions
children.note: Same formatters, different destinations.

children.label: format_to
children.note: Writes through an output iterator and returns the end iterator.

children.label: format_to_n
children.note: Writes at most n characters; size is the untruncated length.

children.label: formatted_size
children.note: Computes the output length without writing anything.

children.label: print and println
children.note: C++23 functions that write to stdout or a FILE*, with Unicode-aware terminal output.

children.label: Unicode and locale
children.note: Widths are in display columns, and locale is opt-in.

children.label: Estimated width
children.note: For UTF-8 literal encoding, wide East Asian characters count as two columns.

children.label: L option
children.note: Only L applies the locale's grouping, radix and bool names; plain {} ignores it.
